question: During the Basic Control Skills test, what is scored as a "pull-up"?
choice_a: Pulling forward on a backing exercise to clear an encroachment or get a better position
choice_b: Sounding the horn upon completion of an exercise
choice_c: Setting the parking brake before exiting the vehicle
choice_d: Stopping without changing direction
explanation: Pull-ups are scored when a driver pulls forward on a backing exercise (Exercise 2 or Exercise 4) to clear an encroachment or get a better position; stopping without changing direction does not count as a pull-up.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: Which two exercises are scored for pull-ups during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Exercise 1 and Exercise 3
choice_b: Exercise 2 and Exercise 4
choice_c: Exercise 1 and Exercise 4
choice_d: Exercise 2 and Exercise 3
explanation: The manual states pull-ups are scored on Exercise 2 (Straight-Line Backing) and Exercise 4 (Reverse Offset Backing).
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: According to the manual, how are initial pull-ups treated when scoring the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Each one automatically fails the test
choice_b: Each one is counted as an encroachment
choice_c: They are not penalized, though an excessive number counts as errors
choice_d: They count double against the final score
explanation: The manual states the driver "will not be penalized for initial pull-ups," although an excessive number of pull-ups will count as errors.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What is scored as an "encroachment" during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Exiting the vehicle to check its position
choice_b: Pulling forward to gain a better backing position
choice_c: Failing to sound the horn upon completion
choice_d: Crossing over or touching an exercise boundary line or cone with any part of the vehicle other than the mirrors
explanation: Encroachments are scored when any part of the vehicle other than the mirrors (or similar high-mounted unique parts) crosses or touches a boundary line or cone.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What must a driver do if they encroach on a boundary line or cone during an exercise?
choice_a: Stop immediately when signaled and return the vehicle within the exercise boundaries
choice_b: Continue the exercise as if nothing happened
choice_c: Immediately exit the vehicle to inspect the boundary
choice_d: Restart the entire Basic Control Skills test from the beginning
explanation: If a driver encroaches, the examiner will stop them, and the driver must return the vehicle within the exercise boundaries, stopping immediately when signaled.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What is scored as a "look" during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: Sounding the horn at the end of an exercise
choice_b: Exiting the vehicle while performing an exercise to check the vehicle's position while backing
choice_c: Checking the mirrors before shifting gears
choice_d: Setting the parking brake before starting an exercise
explanation: A "look" is scored when a driver exits the vehicle during an exercise to check the vehicle's external position while backing.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: When exiting or entering the vehicle to check its position during a backing exercise (other than on a bus), how many points of contact must the driver maintain?
choice_a: One
choice_b: Two
choice_c: Three
choice_d: Four
explanation: Drivers must face the vehicle and maintain three points of contact at all times when entering or exiting during these exercises.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What may happen if a driver opens the vehicle door while the vehicle is moving (not in neutral/park)?
choice_a: It only counts as a single "look"
choice_b: It results in one encroachment penalty
choice_c: Nothing, as long as the vehicle stops soon after
choice_d: It may result in an automatic failure for an unsafe act
explanation: Opening the door while the vehicle is moving, rather than in neutral/park, may result in an automatic failure for an unsafe act.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: How many free looks is a driver allowed on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing?
choice_a: One
choice_b: Two
choice_c: Three
choice_d: Zero
explanation: The manual allows a maximum of one free look on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing to check the position of the vehicle.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: How many free looks is a driver allowed on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing?
choice_a: One
choice_b: Two
choice_c: Three
choice_d: Zero
explanation: The manual allows a maximum of two free looks on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing to check the position of the vehicle.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: On which two exercises is "final position" specifically scored?
choice_a: Exercise 1 and Exercise 2
choice_b: Exercise 1 and Exercise 3
choice_c: Exercise 2 and Exercise 4
choice_d: Exercise 3 and Exercise 4
explanation: The manual states drivers "will be scored for final vehicle position on Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing and on Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing."
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What happens if a driver does not maneuver the vehicle into its final position as instructed by the examiner?
choice_a: Only a single point is deducted
choice_b: The exercise is simply repeated with no penalty
choice_c: The examiner completes the maneuver for the driver
choice_d: The driver is penalized and fails the Basic Control Skills test
explanation: The manual states that failing to maneuver the vehicle into its final position as described will result in penalty and failure of the Basic Control Skills test.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What can result from a "failure to follow instructions or unsafe act" during the Basic Control Skills test?
choice_a: An automatic failure, and the examiner may terminate the test
choice_b: A warning with no further consequence
choice_c: A requirement to repeat only the affected exercise
choice_d: A one-point reduction per instance
explanation: Failure to follow examiner instructions or committing an unsafe act may result in automatic failure, and the examiner may terminate the test.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.1 Scoring

question: What are the four steps of the Basic Control Skills test, in order?
choice_a: Straight-Line Backing, Forward Stop, Reverse Offset Backing, Forward Offset Tracking
choice_b: Forward Stop, Straight-Line Backing, Forward Offset Tracking, Reverse Offset Backing
choice_c: Forward Offset Tracking, Forward Stop, Straight-Line Backing, Reverse Offset Backing
choice_d: Reverse Offset Backing, Forward Offset Tracking, Straight-Line Backing, Forward Stop
explanation: The manual lists the exercises in order as Step 1 Forward Stop, Step 2 Straight-Line Backing, Step 3 Forward Offset Tracking, and Step 4 Reverse Offset Backing.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, exercise overview

question: In Exercise 1 - Forward Stop, how many times may the driver stop?
choice_a: As many times as needed
choice_b: Up to two times
choice_c: Only once
choice_d: Up to three times
explanation: The manual specifies that during Exercise 1 - Forward Stop, the driver "may stop only once."
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.1 Exercise 1 - Forward Stop

question: In Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing, the driver must back straight through the alley until what occurs?
choice_a: The rear of the vehicle passes the starting cones
choice_b: The horn has been sounded three times
choice_c: The examiner raises a hand a second time
choice_d: The front of the vehicle has cleared the last set of cones at the far end of the alley
explanation: In Exercise 2, the driver backs straight through the alley until the front of the vehicle clears the last set of cones at the far end.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.2 Exercise 2 - Straight Line Backing

question: In Exercise 2 - Straight-Line Backing, how many free pull-ups and vehicle exits is the driver allowed?
choice_a: One free pull-up and one exit
choice_b: Two free pull-ups and two exits
choice_c: Zero free pull-ups and one exit
choice_d: One free pull-up and no exits allowed
explanation: The manual allows one free pull-up and permits the driver to safely exit the vehicle only one time to check around it during Exercise 2.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.2 Exercise 2 - Straight Line Backing

question: In Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking, which part of the vehicle must the driver keep between the cone and the line while moving through the opening?
choice_a: The front bumper
choice_b: The right most rear tire
choice_c: The left most rear tire
choice_d: The steering axle
explanation: The driver must steer left through the opening while keeping the right most rear tire between the cone and the line, without stopping.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.3 Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking

question: What happens if a driver stops the vehicle during Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking?
choice_a: The driver receives one free pull-up as compensation
choice_b: Nothing, since stopping is permitted in this exercise
choice_c: The exercise is ended
choice_d: The examiner automatically restarts the exercise
explanation: The manual states a driver is not allowed to stop, back up, or exit the vehicle during Exercise 3; if the driver stops, the exercise will be ended.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.3 Exercise 3 - Forward Offset Tracking

question: In Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing, the rear most part of the vehicle must come within how many feet of the rear of the alley?
choice_a: One foot
choice_b: Two feet
choice_c: Five feet
choice_d: Three feet
explanation: The driver must offset back into the alley, bringing the rear most part of the vehicle within three feet of the rear of the alley.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing

question: In Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing, how many free pull-ups and vehicle exits is the driver allowed?
choice_a: Two free pull-ups and two exits
choice_b: One free pull-up and one exit
choice_c: Zero free pull-ups and two exits
choice_d: Three free pull-ups and one exit
explanation: The manual allows two free pull-ups and permits exiting the vehicle a maximum of two times to check around it during Exercise 4.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing

question: What must a driver do if they back beyond the rear boundary of the alley during Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing?
choice_a: Immediately fail the test with no recovery option
choice_b: Pull straight forward past the alley entrance until signaled by the examiner to stop, then resume
choice_c: Continue reversing until reaching the three-foot box
choice_d: Exit the vehicle to manually measure the distance
explanation: If the driver backs beyond the rear boundary, they must pull straight forward past the alley entrance until signaled by the examiner to stop before resuming the exercise.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 12 - Basic Control Skills Test, 12.2.4 Exercise 4 - Reverse Offset Backing

question: If the test route does not include a certain traffic situation, what may the examiner ask the driver to do?
choice_a: Skip that portion of the evaluation entirely
choice_b: Drive to a different route that includes it
choice_c: Simulate the situation by describing what they are or would be doing
choice_d: Automatically receive full credit for that category
explanation: If a traffic situation is not present on the route, the driver may be asked to simulate it by telling the examiner what they are or would be doing in that situation.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, How You Will Be Tested

question: According to the manual, when does "unsafe coasting" occur while approaching a turn?
choice_a: Whenever the vehicle is in gear
choice_b: When the driver uses the turn signal too early
choice_c: When the driver brakes more than twice
choice_d: When the vehicle is out of gear for more than the length of the vehicle
explanation: Unsafe coasting occurs when the vehicle is out of gear (clutch depressed or gearshift in neutral) for more than the length of the vehicle.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.1 Turns

question: If stopping behind another vehicle before making a turn, what should the driver be able to see to maintain a safe gap?
choice_a: The rear tires of the vehicle ahead
choice_b: The top of the vehicle ahead
choice_c: The license plate light only
choice_d: The driver's side mirror of the vehicle ahead
explanation: The manual instructs that if stopping behind another vehicle, the driver should stop where they can see the rear tires of the vehicle ahead, maintaining a safe gap.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.1 Turns

question: While driving through an intersection, what does the manual say the driver should not do?
choice_a: Keep both hands on the wheel
choice_b: Change lanes while proceeding through the intersection
choice_c: Decelerate and yield to pedestrians
choice_d: Check traffic thoroughly in all directions
explanation: The manual specifically states drivers should "not change lanes while proceeding through the intersection."
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.2 Intersections

question: While stopped at an intersection behind a stop sign, what must the driver's vehicle avoid doing?
choice_a: Using the parking brake
choice_b: Signaling a turn
choice_c: Rolling forward or backward
choice_d: Idling for more than 30 seconds
explanation: The manual states that when stopped, "your vehicle must not roll forward or backward."
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.2 Intersections

question: During the "Urban Business" portion of the on-road test, in which lane should the vehicle generally be centered?
choice_a: The left-most lane
choice_b: Whichever lane has the least traffic
choice_c: Straddling two lanes for visibility
choice_d: The right-most lane
explanation: During Urban Business driving, the vehicle should be centered in the proper lane, the right-most lane, keeping up with traffic without exceeding the posted speed limit.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.3 Urban Business

question: What must a driver do before changing lanes during the multiple-lane portion of the on-road test?
choice_a: Make necessary traffic checks first, then use proper signals
choice_b: Change lanes immediately, then check mirrors afterward
choice_c: Sound the horn to alert other drivers
choice_d: Come to a complete stop before changing lanes
explanation: The manual requires making the necessary traffic checks first, then using proper signals and smoothly changing lanes when safe.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.4 Lane Changes

question: Once on the exit ramp of an expressway, what must the driver continue to do?
choice_a: Accelerate to merge back onto the expressway
choice_b: Continue to decelerate within the lane markings and maintain adequate spacing
choice_c: Change lanes to find the fastest route off the ramp
choice_d: Activate the four-way flashers
explanation: Once on the exit ramp, drivers must continue to decelerate within the lane markings and maintain adequate spacing between their vehicle and others.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.5 Expressway or Rural/Limited Access Highway

question: During the Stop/Start maneuver, after the vehicle has come to a stop, what should the driver activate?
choice_a: The left turn signal
choice_b: The headlights
choice_c: The four-way emergency flashers
choice_d: The horn repeatedly
explanation: Once stopped for the Stop/Start maneuver, the driver should cancel the turn signal and activate the four-way emergency flashers, along with applying the parking brake.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.6 Stop/Start

question: When approaching a curve, when should the driver reduce speed?
choice_a: While already in the curve
choice_b: Only if traffic requires it
choice_c: Immediately after exiting the curve
choice_d: Before entering the curve, so no further braking or shifting is required in the curve
explanation: The manual states that before entering a curve, the driver should reduce speed so that further braking or shifting is not required within the curve.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.7 Curve

question: For all commercial drivers, what is prohibited while any part of the vehicle is in a railroad crossing?
choice_a: Stopping, changing gears, passing another vehicle, or changing lanes
choice_b: Using turn signals
choice_c: Checking traffic in all directions
choice_d: Braking smoothly before the crossing
explanation: The manual prohibits stopping, changing gears, passing another vehicle, or changing lanes while any part of the vehicle is in the railroad crossing.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.8 Railroad Crossing

question: Drivers of buses, school buses, or vehicles displaying placards must stop within what distance range from the nearest rail at a railroad crossing (unless exempt)?
choice_a: Within 100 feet but not less than 50 feet
choice_b: Within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet
choice_c: Within 25 feet but not less than 5 feet
choice_d: Within 10 feet but not less than 3 feet
explanation: The manual requires these vehicles to stop within 50 feet but not less than 15 feet from the nearest rail.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.8 Railroad Crossing

question: After driving under an overpass during the on-road test, what may the examiner ask the driver to state?
choice_a: The speed limit on the overpass
choice_b: The number of lanes on the overpass
choice_c: The posted clearance or height
choice_d: The name of the road
explanation: After driving under an overpass, the driver may be asked to tell the examiner what the posted clearance or height was.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.9 Bridge/Overpass/Sign

question: When stopping for a student discharge with a School Bus endorsement, how far from students must the bus stop, at minimum?
choice_a: 5 feet
choice_b: 15 feet
choice_c: 20 feet
choice_d: 10 feet
explanation: The manual requires the school bus to come to a complete stop at least 10 feet away from students at the stop.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.10 Student Discharge (School Bus)

question: According to the manual, what must a driver do when shifting an unsynchronized manual transmission?
choice_a: Double-clutch when shifting
choice_b: Rev the engine before each shift
choice_c: Ride the clutch to control speed
choice_d: Coast with the clutch depressed
explanation: If equipped with an unsynchronized manual transmission, the driver must double-clutch when shifting, and must not rev or lug the engine.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.11(a) Clutch Usage (for Manual Transmission)

question: According to the manual's Lane Usage guidance, where should a driver finish a left turn on a multiple-lane road?
choice_a: In the right-most lane
choice_b: In the lane directly to the right of the center line
choice_c: In any open lane
choice_d: Straddling two lanes
explanation: The vehicle should finish a left turn in the lane directly to the right of the center line, per the Lane Usage section.
source_note: Oregon Commercial Driver License Manual, Section 13 - On-road Driving, 13.1.14(d) Lane Usage
